items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: But, I found it later on to be terribly unrewarding instrument ‘cause it’s got so damn much resistance and it’s bored out almost all, two-thirds cylindrical, one-third conical like a regular trumpet, except double the size. Too much resistance, it saps your strength and doesn’t give anything back, whereas I have a marching trombone now even though I don’t play which is like, Al Grey plays it, it’s like a bass flugelhorn. It’s a lovely thing to play and the valve trombone is a nice instrument to play. I’d say the…
So how did you get involved with Gil and that whole circle of people?
